# Access Control Standard

Revision: v03. Effective: 2023-11-23. Owner: Head of Information Security.

## 1. Purpose

This document sets the minimum requirements for access control. It exists so that every team applies the same
rules the same way, and so that an auditor can check that they do.

## 2. Scope

This document applies to every employee, contractor and system of the company. Where a contract or a law imposes a stricter
requirement, the stricter requirement applies.

## 3. Definitions

- In-scope systems: every system listed in the asset register with this policy as its control set.
- Owner: the role accountable for this document and for approving exceptions to it.
- Confirmed event: an event that the response team has classified, as opposed to a report.
- Working day: Monday to Friday excluding public holidays at the registered office.

## 4. Requirements

- **R1.** Affected parties are notified within 3 days of a confirmed event.
- **R2.** This document is reviewed every 24 months and after any incident that invokes it.
- **R3.** Passwords are at least 14 characters long and are checked against a list of known compromised passwords.
- **R4.** Staff complete the related training within thirty days of joining and annually thereafter.
- **R5.** Third parties handling in-scope data are bound by a written agreement that imposes equivalent requirements.
- **R6.** Records covered by this policy are retained for 365 days from the date of their creation and then deleted.
- **R7.** Encryption in transit uses current, non-deprecated protocol versions only.
- **R8.** Monitoring alerts are triaged within one business hour during working hours.

## 5. Exceptions

Exceptions are granted only where a requirement cannot be met for technical or legal reasons, are
time-limited, and are reviewed at every scheduled review of this document.

## 6. Review and ownership

The owner of this document is the Head of Information Security, who approves exceptions and signs off every revision.
Material changes are communicated to all affected teams before they take effect.
